mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business confidence decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals a weakening demand side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals a disinflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real income and purchasing power increase.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises simultaneously, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as both consumer and investor confidence wane.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines and UNRATE rises in the same month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases and real GDP (GDPC1) grows at the same time, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and economic outlook improve.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases and GDPC1 grows in the same quarter
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases and GDPC1 grows simultaneously.
